name: comp-169
blurb: Three theme previews with checkmarks, one radio button selected.
description: Theme selector using radio buttons with preview images and conditional icons. Built on shadcn's RadioGroup.
use_when: Allowing users to choose a visual theme or style when preview images clarify the choice.
avoid_when: When images cannot be reliably loaded or when there are more than 5 options.
a11y: Built on accessible RadioGroup with hidden radio inputs, image alt text, and conditional icon visibility based on state.
